quest.title: The Fatal Fetish
quest.description: I like to imagine that as you made your way to the capital, a feeling of dark dread crept slowly over you. Of course, this is merely a storyteller's fancy. For all I know, you may have been gleefully giddy with anticipation of the horrors ahead!

node.instruction: Locate and investigate the site of the ritual referred to in the note.
node.journal_entry: ...and then, SQUELCH! Even before you looked down, you somehow knew there was something positively horrid now decorating the underside of your boot. The slimy texture mingled with the suddenly overpowering stench of days old blood and flesh was prelude enough to the gory sight of the now decaying ritual site before you. Why had nobody cleaned this up?!

node.instruction: Interact with the portal to enter the sewers beneath the city.
node.journal_entry: The pooling rivulets of blood and flesh that made their way inexorably down the sewers was sign enough that you were on the right track. "Right," was, of course, a matter of perspective. What possessed you to keep following the trail is beyond me but, on the other hand, I suppose that had you not continued, we would not be telling this tale now!

node.instruction: Follow the trails of blood inside the sewers.
node.journal_entry: Finally, after a hellish trek through the bowels of a city that was apparently suffering a bout of heartburn and indigestion, you came at last to the inner chamber, and that is where you saw her...and she saw you. The $[Resource.S.r_scumling_queen_NameSingular] .

It was clear from the moment you laid your eyes upon her that the so called "Queen" was somehow wrong. Some dark and rotten magic was affecting and suffusing her entire being. Very soon, once her corpse yielded its possessions, you discovered what it was.

action.tag: A Start Client SFX on Specific Object Action

node.journal_entry: You felt your very soul dry heave and gag as you held the putrid fetish before you. Here was a thing of clearly dark and twisted design, crafted from the flesh of the dead and used in some dark ritual.

Even as you entered through the gates, something told you it was too late. There was a tension, a palpable feeling of a horrible deed hanging in the air, in the veiled expressions of the locals and, you would soon find, on the very stones that paved the roads themselves...
A brief investigation of the scene divulged nothing of those who had been here, yet your curiosity, or perhaps some righteous need for justice, seemed to drive you on.

node.instruction: Talk to an Acolyte of the Watcher about the Fetish.
node.journal_entry: The Acolyte you spoke to seemed to sag beneath the weight of the violence you revealed. They simply could not understand that being peaceful does not protect one from the evil of the world. Broken as the hooded one was, he could offer no concrete advice other than the mumbled suggestion that you seek one who could explain what the Fetish was...
You concluded that, likely, the Acolytes would like to know what happened to their fallen brethren.

quest_item.description_unlocked: A fetish created by dark rituals and blood magic that included the flesh of Acolytes of the Watcher
